description:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.  

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

Design is foundational to our product and our company. As a Product Designer at Profound, you will work on our core data visualization and content workflow tools. This is an opportunity to have deep ownership over our product and ship fast and ship often, while continuing to craft the experience for our users.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design core product experiences end to end, from early exploration through launch and iteration

 - Work closely with product managers and engineers to translate strategy and ambiguous problems into clear, thoughtful solutions

 - Explore multiple directions quickly through sketches, flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs

 - Sweat the details and fine tune layout shifts, typography, spacing, motion, and interactions

 - Balance building good product focused on user needs, technical constraints, and business goals while keeping a high bar for craft

 - Use user feedback, qualitative insights, and product intuition to refine and improve the product over time

 - Contribute to and help evolve Profound’s design language, systems, and product vision

 - Participate in Tuesday and Thursday design critiques to give and receive feedback on in-progress design work




WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 3 or more years of experience designing digital products, ideally in a startup or fast-moving product company

 - You are a strong generalist with taste and are comfortable owning the full stack of design assets, from flows to pixels to final product

 - You care deeply about craft and believe great design is defined by clarity, simplicity, and execution

 - You bring an entrepreneurial and product-thinking mindset to design

 - You like to experiment with AI, new tools, and ways of working, whether through new Figma plugins or tools such as v0, Cursor, or other prototyping tools

 - You are good at collaborating with product managers, engineers, and data scientists to solve problems

 - You have a portfolio that shows thoughtful problem-solving and high-quality visual design

 - Experience working on a data visualization or B2B marketing product

 - Enjoy prototyping directly in code and shipping directly to production using git and GitHub

 - Blur the lines between where design ends and product or engineering work begins

 - You can just do things




NOTE FROM OUR CO-FOUNDER

In the evolving landscape of product development, exceptional design is not merely a nice-to-have, it is foundational. As software engineering becomes increasingly accessible, it is taste, creativity, and thoughtful execution that differentiate outstanding products from the rest.

I believe deeply that design sits at the core of our success. At Profound, my goal is to build a design team renowned for setting a new standard of excellence, crafting experiences so compelling they become benchmarks in our industry.

If you are someone who believes in the transformative power of great design and wants to create work that genuinely shapes the future, join us. Let’s redefine what’s possible together.

Dylan Babbs, Co-founder & CTO




LOCATION

This is an on-site role based in our NYC, SF or Buenos Aires office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. 

For this role, the expected base salary range is $120,000 to $250,000 (NYC and SF). Comp may vary by location. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring.

Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.
